Hi, I try to build rustls with either ring feature or aws-lc-rs feature with nightly and wasip3 target but both failed on Windows 11.
On Ubuntu, building with ring feature work as expected
I guess I have to setup something else on Windows?

Both ring and aws-lc-rs need a C compiler (in the case of wasi it needs a C compiler that can compile to wasm, so you must make sure it uses clang (preferably from wasi-sdk), not msvc or gcc). I'm not sure to what extent either of them supports compiling for wasm. They tend to use crypto routines written in assembly by default, which isn't portable across architectures.

And during linking, I get

  = note: some arguments are omitted. use `--verbose` to show all linker arguments                = note: rust-lld: error: unknown argument: --cooperative-threading                                      error: failed to invoke LLD: exit status: 1

I don't enable this feature, I just run cargo build --target wasm32-wasip3

I update to llvm 23 on Ubuntu.
